parole.significato: A South American bird, Psophia crepitans, allied to the cranes, and easily domesticated.
parole.testo: From French agami, from Kari'na akami.
From French courlan, courliri (compare courlis, corlieu), ultimately from Kari'na karau. Compare carrao, from Guaraní.
